lines.translation: In the realm of humility, the Word is Beauty.
Forms of incomparable beauty are fashioned there.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੀਆ ਗਲਾ ਕਥੀਆ ਨਾ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: taa keeaa galaa katheeaa naa jaahi ||
lines.translation: These things cannot be described.
One who tries to speak of these shall regret the attempt.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਥੈ ਘੜੀਐ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਬੁਧਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: tithai ghaReeai surat mat man budh ||
lines.translation: The intuitive consciousness, intellect and understanding of the mind are shaped there.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਥੈ ਘੜੀਐ ਸੁਰਾ ਸਿਧਾ ਕੀ ਸੁਧਿ ॥੩੬॥
lines.transliteration: tithai ghaReeai suraa sidhaa kee sudh ||36||
lines.translation: The consciousness of the spiritual warriors and the Siddhas, the beings of spiritual perfection, are shaped there. ||36||
In the realm of karma, the Word is Power.
No one else dwells there,
except the warriors of great power, the spiritual heroes.
They are totally fulfilled, imbued with the Lord's Essence.
Myriads of Sitas are there, cool and calm in their majestic glory.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੇ ਰੂਪ ਨ ਕਥਨੇ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: taa ke roop na kathane jaahi ||
lines.translation: Their beauty cannot be described.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਓਹਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਨ ਠਾਗੇ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: naa ohi marahi na thaage jaahi ||
lines.translation: Neither death nor deception comes to those,

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਰਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin kai raam vasai man maahi ||
lines.translation: within whose minds the Lord abides.
The devotees of many worlds dwell there.
They celebrate; their minds are imbued with the True Lord.
In the realm of Truth, the Formless Lord abides.
Having created the creation, He watches over it. By His Glance of Grace, He bestows happiness.
There are planets, solar systems and galaxies.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਕਥੈ ਤ ਅੰਤ ਨ ਅੰਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: je ko kathai ta a(n)t na a(n)t ||
lines.translation: If one speaks of them, there is no limit, no end.
There are worlds upon worlds of His Creation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਵ ਜਿਵ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਤਿਵੈ ਤਿਵ ਕਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: jiv jiv hukam tivai tiv kaar ||
lines.translation: As He commands, so they exist.
He watches over all, and contemplating the creation, He rejoices.
O Nanak, to describe this is as hard as steel! ||37||
Let self-control be the furnace, and patience the goldsmith.
Let understanding be the anvil, and spiritual wisdom the tools.
With the Fear of God as the bellows, fan the flames of tapa, the body's inner heat.
In the crucible of love, melt the Nectar of the Name,
and mint the True Coin of the Shabad, the Word of God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਮੁ ਤਿਨ ਕਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin kau nadar karam tin kaar ||
lines.translation: Such is the karma of those upon whom He has cast His Glance of Grace.
O Nanak, the Merciful Lord, by His Grace, uplifts and exalts them. ||38||
Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਵਣੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਪਾਣੀ ਪਿਤਾ ਮਾਤਾ ਧਰਤਿ ਮਹਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: pavan guroo paanee pitaa maataa dharat mahat ||
lines.translation: Air is the Guru, Water is the Father, and Earth is the Great Mother of all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਿਵਸੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਦੁਇ ਦਾਈ ਦਾਇਆ ਖੇਲੈ ਸਗਲ ਜਗਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: divas raat dui daaee daaiaa khelai sagal jagat ||
lines.translation: Day and night are the two nurses, in whose lap all the world is at play.
Good deeds and bad deeds-the record is read out in the Presence of the Lord of Dharma.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਮੀ ਆਪੋ ਆਪਣੀ ਕੇ ਨੇੜੈ ਕੇ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: karamee aapo aapanee ke neRai ke door ||
lines.translation: According to their own actions, some are drawn closer, and some are driven farther away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਗਏ ਮਸਕਤਿ ਘਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinee naam dhiaaiaa gae masakat ghaal ||
lines.translation: Those who have meditated on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and departed after having worked by the sweat of their brows

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਕੇਤੀ ਛੁਟੀ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak te mukh ujale ketee chhutee naal ||1||
lines.translation: -O Nanak, their faces are radiant in the Court of the Lord, and many are saved along with them! ||1||
So Dar ~ That Door. Raag Aasaa, First Mehl:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਦਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੇਹਾ ਸੋ ਘਰੁ ਕੇਹਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਬਹਿ ਸਰਬ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: so dar teraa kehaa so ghar kehaa jit bahi sarab samaale ||
lines.translation: Where is That Door of Yours, and where is That Home, in which You sit and take care of all?

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਾਜੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਦ ਅਨੇਕ ਅਸੰਖਾ ਕੇਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਵਾਵਣਹਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: vaaje tere naad anek asa(n)khaa kete tere vaavanahaare ||
lines.translation: The Sound-current of the Naad vibrates there for You, and countless musicians play all sorts of instruments there for You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਰਾਗ ਪਰੀ ਸਿਉ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਗਾਵਣਹਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kete tere raag paree siu kaheeahi kete tere gaavanahaare ||
lines.translation: There are so many Ragas and musical harmonies to You; so many minstrels sing hymns of You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਪਵਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਗਾਵੈ ਰਾਜਾ ਧਰਮੁ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gaavan tudhano pavan paanee baisa(n)tar gaavai raajaa dharam duaare ||
lines.translation: Wind, water and fire sing of You. The Righteous Judge of Dharma sings at Your Door.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਚਿਤੁ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਲਿਖਿ ਜਾਣਨਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਧਰਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gaavan tudhano chit gupat likh jaanan likh likh dharam beechaare ||
lines.translation: Chitr and Gupt, the angels of the conscious and the subconscious who keep the record of actions, and the Righteous Judge of Dharma who reads this record, sing of You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਈਸਰੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਦੇਵੀ ਸੋਹਨਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gaavan tudhano eesar brahamaa devee sohan tere sadaa savaare ||
lines.translation: Shiva, Brahma and the Goddess of Beauty, ever adorned by You, sing of You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਇੰਦ੍ਰਾਸਣਿ ਬੈਠੇ ਦੇਵਤਿਆ ਦਰਿ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gaavan tudhano i(n)dr i(n)draasan baithe devatiaa dar naale ||
lines.translation: Indra, seated on His Throne, sings of You, with the deities at Your Door.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਸਿਧ ਸਮਾਧੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਸਾਧ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gaavan tudhano sidh samaadhee a(n)dar gaavan tudhano saadh beechaare ||
lines.translation: The Siddhas in Samaadhi sing of You; the Saadhus sing of You in contemplation.
